Theorem
[Hamilton--Ivey estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0392 1. appD:D.17\group Curvature Pinching

Let $(\mathcal M^3,g(t))$ be a complete Ricci flow with bounded curvature and $\lambda _{\min }(\operatorname {Rm})(\cdot ,0)\geq -1$. Wherever $\lambda _{\min }(\operatorname {Rm})<0$, \[ R\geq |\lambda _{\min }|\bigl(\log |\lambda _{\min }|+log(1+t)-3\bigr), \] and hence $R\geq |\lambda _{\min }|(\log |\lambda _{\min }|-3)$.
